title: Separating bases over perfect fields
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] of characteristic zero, or of characteristic $p>0$ in which every element is a $p$th power. Let $E/F$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] generated as a field by finitely many elements. There are finitely many $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in E$ forming a transcendence basis of $E/F$ [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis] such that $E/F(t_1,\ldots,t_r)$ is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. The empty basis is allowed.
